catalog.name: Banana matcha
catalog.typical_price: no US menu price found; banana pudding matcha einspanner $9.99 (Cere Tea)
catalog.note: Banana cream pie latte went viral from Academic Coffee, San Jose; banana matcha followed (MALK x Cha Cha Matcha pop-up, April 2026).

catalog.name: Cloud foam matcha
catalog.typical_price: no plain price found; cloud drinks $9.49 (Cere Tea)
catalog.note: Cloud foam is the 2026 topping; one report cites searches for cloud matcha up several hundred percent.

catalog.name: Iced matcha latte
catalog.typical_price: $7.99 (Cere Tea, Burlingame CA); about $7 typical (LA Magazine)
catalog.note: The baseline every pop-up sells; every other drink here is a variation on it.

catalog.name: Strawberry cloud matcha
catalog.note: Strawberry Clouds Matcha Latte appears at the Beverly Hills Hotel (La La Land Kind Cafe) and on cafe menus.

catalog.name: Strawberry matcha
catalog.note: Named by 2026 flavour reports as a lead matcha pairing; the red-over-green layered look is the most photographed pop-up drink.

catalog.name: Ube matcha
catalog.note: Ube is the 2026 press pick as the next matcha; Starbucks ran an ube lineup in spring 2026; purple under green is the signature look.

catalog.name: Banana pudding matcha
catalog.typical_price: $9.99 (Cere Tea einspanner); S$9.50 at Haus Coffee, Singapore
catalog.note: Dessert-pudding matcha seen at Cere Tea and overseas viral cafes (Big Wiss Matcha also lists it).

catalog.name: Black sesame matcha
catalog.note: Symrise expects brands to move toward ube, black sesame and hojicha after matcha and yuzu.

catalog.name: Brown sugar boba matcha
catalog.typical_price: not found (a brown sugar matcha latte with mascarpone is on Junbi menus, price unread)
catalog.note: Boba is the long-running pairing; no 2026 price found, popularity is from category reports.

catalog.name: Coconut cloud matcha
catalog.note: Coconut Cloud Matcha is a named drink in an Instagram menu reveal; coconut cream clouds are rising.

catalog.name: Coconut matcha
catalog.note: Coconut matcha is a signature at LA cafes such as Damo Tea House.

catalog.name: Gingerbread matcha
catalog.note: Appears on multiple Nov 2026 holiday menus including a cinnamon roll variant.

catalog.name: Hojicha latte
catalog.note: Roasted, caffeine-lighter alternative; gaining in 2026 reports.

catalog.name: Hot matcha latte

catalog.name: Mango matcha

catalog.name: Matcha einspanner
catalog.note: Cream-capped Vienna style; Cere Tea sells ten einspanner variants.

catalog.name: Matcha lemonade
catalog.note: Named with matcha lemonade cookies in the AOL roundup of 2026 matcha products.

catalog.name: Matcha soft serve

catalog.name: Matcha tiramisu
